steps.name: Severin
steps.text: —When did they appear?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: I'm not sure. But the 'Gramophone' didn't start...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I told you before not to rely on those experimental automatic Arts devices.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: If they have some educated Leithanians in that Infected group, they could have easily turned a machine against us.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Too late for that. The Infected quarter is crawling with them. They're whipping them up.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...The people here should be above that kind of provocation.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: B-but there are more and more protesters every day. They're gathering up and—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What are their demands?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They want us to start supplying Zwölftontechnik Strasse again... and they want all quarantine measures on Zwölftontechnik Strasse lifted.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...Nonsense.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Of course, their main demand is that we give an appropriate response to the fire...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They don't give a rat's ass about the fire. Just you wait, everyone will forget what this was about soon enough.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: What should we do? Rhodes Island is already here. It's only a matter of time before they find out.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We all know that. Why do you think I sent Tatjana with them?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Before we lay it all out for Rhodes Island, we have to be sure what kind of company they are. We have to know if they're Atro's kind of Infected, or 'the other' kind.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: I'm not sure that's right... Won't things just get worse once they find out on their own what we're hiding?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Ha... Think what you will. If they're the type to turn the other cheek, that's what they'll do. You and I both know what's going on here in Wolumonde.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: I know, but—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: —Then don't try to play the good guy here. Things don't work out for the good guys. We need to focus on outcomes.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*... What about the real nasty ones? Like the devils?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They haven't made formal contact yet...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They're a bunch of vultures, stirring up our people, looking to divide and conquer. How trite of them.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They're playing it cool, probing our defenses. When they're sure there's no Gendarmerie garrisoned in Wolumonde...

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Everyone here is ready to fight. And we have the L-44 'Gramophone' defense system.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But you're not Gendarmerie... *Sigh*, I'm just trying not to get anyone killed, *cough*— *cough* *cough* *hack*—

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Take care of yourself. Wolumonde can't afford to lose you.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Really? I don't think it makes much difference...

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Who else could keep Wolumonde's defenses up without a single Gendarmerie?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It's just stubborn blood. Leithanian nobles won't stoop to doing their own dirty work. Give them one more push and you'll see this place go to hell in a handbasket.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: If we don't come up with something soon, this game is over.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We have to get back on our normal course before winter. Stay stuck in this wasteland and watch starvation and rioting destroy the town.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Maybe... Yes, you're right.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It's already getting cold, *cough*—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...I hope Wolumonde still has other options.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Hey! Where are you two from?!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Are you here to help those morons keep us locked up in here to die?!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Know your place!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Who were you talking to just now? What did you tell him?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Hah. You scared? You should be!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: It's because you bureaucrats can't do shit that Wolumonde is in this mess!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Why don't you let us try running the show for a while?!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: This isn't anyone's fault!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: You're just gonna call it a Catastrophe and be done with it?! It's your fault we couldn't steer away from it in the first place!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...You're begging for a fight, Infected.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Have you been to any other cities? Have you seen how other Infected live?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even I can see that Wolumonde is in a crisis, but the non-infected are going through the same tough times as you Infected. Shouldn't you be working together to get through this?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Huh? And who the hell are you?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm a Rhodes Island Operator, an Infected doctor. We help the Infected through crises, as long as they're not stirring up trouble for no reason.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: G-good day. C-could you please stop resisting...?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Pfah! You're here to kick us around. If I let you, that is—!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: You want us to work together? Why don't you ask the woman who started all this?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: That...

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Hey, you. You're infected, aren't you?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Nine-tailed Vulpos are pretty rare. Sooner or later, you'll end up just like us.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I don't think so... Everyone's so nice to me...

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: For now. But that won't last forever. Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow, but soon enough.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: If only Dr. Atro was here...

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Hey! What are you doing?! Let go!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What did you just say?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic, calm down!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Did you just say 'Dr. Atro?'

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Where is she? Is she alright?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: What do you mean where is she? The fire took everything from us!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: They've been pushing us out since the Great Rift appeared. They're terrified!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: They even rounded up the Infected who came here seeking refuge! Why? Because they have to control us, to lock us up like animals, all to satisfy their twisted idea of humanism!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: That's not true... the Schultz isn't like that!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Feh. Whatever. If that's all it was, we'd be fine too...

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: At least we had Dr. Atro. At least we had each other. Even if we lost this quarter, we at least had a place to stay...

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: But they... they killed Dr. Atro, and our friends!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Because of that fire!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: ...Wh-what do you want?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Atro should have survived that fire.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Oh, I get it. They lied to you. Of course. They lie to everyone.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: It wasn't an accident. It was arson. It was murder. It was self-righteous moralizers showing their true colors.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm not your therapist. Let's cool the emotional venting—

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Heh. You know what they didn't tell you?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Wait, stop!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: ...The day that fire happened, not a single person made it out of that tent!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You mean...?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: I think you know whose side you should be on.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Gah! Take it easy already!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: ...Behave yourself. You're under arrest.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: You're no Gendarmerie! None of you are! There's no law here! All we got is leftovers from the settlers!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: The Schultz will decide your fate. I'm sorry.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Hmph. You wouldn't dare kill me. You wouldn't risk a mass Infected uprising!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: I guess I'll just wait for you to exile me to the wasteland so I can join up with the—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: ...You and your friends are convinced that we are the ones behind all this.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But we're all fellow citizens of Wolumonde, and we're all a part of this town together. We've lived in peace for so many years—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Why would you trust some the word of some strange outsiders over ours?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: What have we done wrong?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: ...Because you are not one of the Winterwisp. Nor are you Infected. You're just a sheltered little girl.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: You forget what it means to be Infected. You forget what Oripathy is. I know better than you. It's that simple.

steps.name: Militiaman
steps.text: Here! Tatjana is here!

steps.name: Militiaman
steps.text: And Rhodes Island! Are you two okay?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yes, we're fine!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Take them away, please.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Ugh. I have to see Severin again...

steps.name: Militiaman
steps.text: We'll make sure they don't do anything else. But Miss Tatjana, what of the two from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I will take care of them.

steps.name: Militiaman
steps.text: Very well. Then, we'll go on ahead.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Now can you give me an explanation?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I... I will tell you everything.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I don't know what Schultz Severin and the councilors are thinking. But I believe... Miss Folinic and Miss Suzuran, I believe you deserve to know the truth.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Considering how you just helped me...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You're wasting time. I just want to know... is she alive?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I... I don't know...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You don't know?!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Please, Miss Folinic.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Tatjana... why are you lying to me?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: None of us are really ready to accept it ourselves.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Please understand, we don't know what Rhodes Island is like. We had to be sure we could trust—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even if we were ruthless, cold-blooded corporate raiders out to make everything worse for Wolumonde, that's no excuse for you to deceive our people!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I'm sorry... I really am...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: We were planning to tell you the truth...! We, we've been doing everything we can to investigate the Infected outside the town!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But I know. I know that's all just for our own sake. It's no excuse...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Exactly right. You're making excuses. But... it's fine.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: All I want... is the truth. Rhodes Island won't abandon you. We wouldn't look past a town suffering a crisis like this.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That would make Atro very unhappy. She's such a baby whenever she gets sad. And I hate seeing her cry.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's not too late. For either of us.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Helping the Infected and solving their problems is what being a Rhodes Island Operator is all about.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Tatjana, there's so much we can do if we just trust each other!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Before the Catastrophe, the Schultz asked Dr. Atro if she would leave with the refugees...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Dr. Atro said the same thing—'Rhodes Island won't abandon you.'

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Please come with me.
